title: Listing Highlight: 105 Azimut Grande 105 2012
description: Experience the ultimate in maritime luxury with the 2012 Azimut Grande 105, featuring lavish accommodations for ten and breathtaking outdoor entertainment spaces.
html:
A True Expression Of Luxury And Mediterranean Elegance On The Water

Gliding across the water with an unmistakable silhouette, the 2012 Azimut Grande 105 represents the pinnacle of Italian maritime craftsmanship. This striking motor yacht effortlessly blends high-performance engineering with the kind of sophisticated aesthetic that has made its builder a household name among luxury seafarers. From the moment one steps aboard, it is clear that every inch of this 105-foot vessel was designed to maximize both comfort and visual appeal, offering an oasis of tranquility on the open ocean.

The exterior lines of the 2012 Azimut Grande 105 are sleek and dynamic, hinting at the vessel’s capability for swift and smooth passages. The expansive outdoor spaces are intelligently distributed across multiple decks, providing guests with a variety of environments to soak in the sun or enjoy a shaded sea breeze. The aft deck serves as a welcoming gateway, flowing seamlessly into the main salon, while the sundeck above offers a panoramic vantage point ideal for entertaining or quiet reflection.

Moving into the interior, the sheer volume of the yacht becomes immediately apparent. The main living areas are bathed in natural light, thanks to oversized windows that frame the ever-changing seascape. Here, bespoke Italian furnishings and premium finishes create an atmosphere of refined elegance. This central hub is perfectly suited for hosting intimate gatherings, supported by a state-of-the-art entertainment system and an open, airy layout that encourages effortless socialization.

Accommodation on board is nothing short of lavish, with space to comfortably sleep up to ten guests across beautifully appointed staterooms. The master suite is a private sanctuary, featuring expansive proportions, luxurious materials, and an en-suite bathroom that rivals top-tier resort spas. The additional guest cabins are equally thoughtful in their design, ensuring that everyone on board enjoys a first-class experience tailored to rest and relaxation.

Behind the scenes, the yacht is equipped to cater to the most discerning culinary desires. A fully outfitted gourmet galley allows a professional crew to prepare world-class meals, whether it is a casual breakfast on the aft deck or a formal dining experience in the main salon. Ultimately, the 2012 Azimut Grande 105 stands as a highly desirable platform for both private getaways and lucrative charter operations, promising an unforgettable journey every time the lines are cast off.
